## Overview `compile_mm_encoder` on the Transformers backend crashes engine init with `ValueError: No dynamic dimensions found` for encoders whose `forward` leaves tensor inputs unannotated (SigLIP, Idefics3/SmolVLM) or uses legacy tensor types (`torch.BoolTensor`). This resolves the `dynamic_arg_dims=None` TODO by inferring the dims from the encoder's `forward` signature. Part of #63635 (blocker 1 of 3); not a fix for blockers 2 and 3 there, so no `Fixes`. ## Claims - SmolVLM-256M and the SigLIP encoder (LLaVA-OneVision) no longer fail at decoration time; SmolVLM-256M now compiles its encoder end to end and generates the same tokens as with compile off. - Encoders annotated `torch.Tensor` behave as before (InternVL3-1B-hf checked). The only difference is that legacy-typed arguments such as `bool_masked_pos` (`None` in these runs) are now also listed, and the decorator skips `None`. - Does **not** make LLaVA-OneVision or Qwen3-VL work: they still fail further down in Dynamo (blockers 3 and 2 in #63635), unchanged by this PR. ## Validation **Regression test, before and after the fix** (new `test_compile_mm_encoder` in `tests/models/transformers/test_backend.py`; A10G, transformers 5.22.1, rebased head `4e4c3dcbf5` with the fix reverted and the test kept, then with the fix applied): ``` $ VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 python -m pytest tests/models/transformers/test_backend.py -k test_compile_mm_encoder -v # before (test only) test_compile_mm_encoder[disabled] PASSED [ 50%] test_compile_mm_encoder[enabled] FAILED [100%] E ValueError: No dynamic dimensions found in the forward method of . Please provide dynamic_arg_dims explicitly. vllm/compilation/decorators.py:235: ValueError ====== 1 failed, 1 passed, 41 deselected, 2 warnings in 50.86s ======= # after (test + fix) test_compile_mm_encoder[disabled] PASSED [ 50%] test_compile_mm_encoder[enabled] PASSED [100%] =========== 2 passed, 41 deselected, 2 warnings in 69.57s =========== ``` **CPU unit tests** (`test_dynamic_arg_dims.py` plus two neighbouring existing files), same box: ``` $ python -m pytest tests/models/transformers/test_dynamic_arg_dims.py tests/models/transformers/test_dynamic_rope.py tests/models/transformers/test_layer_registry.py -v ============================== 23 passed, 2 xfailed in 7.82s ============================== ``` `pre-commit run --files ` passes (ruff, mypy, typos, SPDX, "Check new tests are wired into Buildkite CI"). **Manual end-to-end** (not CI): the script and commands are in #63635, `compile_mm_encoder=True`, one 336x336 image, greedy, 3 tokens or fewer, A10G, transformers 5.22.1, with this change applied: | Model | Result | |---|---| | SmolVLM-256M-Instruct | `RESULT: OK text= ' Red.' token_ids= [3950, 30, 49279]` (identical to compile off); `[Idefics3VisionTransformer] Compiling a graph for compile range (1, 2147483647) takes 20.65 s` | | InternVL3-1B-hf (regression check) | `RESULT: OK text= 'Red' token_ids= [6033, 151645]` (identical to compile off); `[InternVLVisionModel] Compiling a graph ... takes 19.14 s` | | llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b | `ValueError` gone; `[SiglipVisionModel] Starting torch.compile`, then `torch._dynamo.exc.Unsupported: Unsupported context manager` (blocker 3, unchanged) | | Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct | `GuardOnDataDependentSymNode: Could not guard on data-dependent expression Eq(u7, 0)` (blocker 2, unchanged) | One image and a few greedy tokens show the encoder compiles and agrees with eager on that input, not broader correctness. **CI coverage.** The unit test runs in `:computer: (CPU) Basic Models Other` (wired in this PR). `test_compile_mm_encoder` is in `test_backend.py`, which already runs in `:nvidia: (H200 MIG 35GB) Basic Models (Other)`; I validated it on an A10G, not on that machine. ## Details - **Root cause:** `support_torch_compile` infers dynamic args only from `torch.Tensor` / `torch.FloatTensor` / `IntermediateTensors` annotations. SigLIP's `pixel_values` is unannotated; Idefics3 also takes a `torch.BoolTensor` mask that must be dynamic too. With only `pixel_values` marked, Dynamo raises `ConstraintViolationError ... specialized it to be a constant (119)` at `modeling_idefics3.py:167`. - **Design:** `infer_dynamic_arg_dims` (in `transformers/utils.py`) returns dim 0 for each non-variadic `forward` parameter that is unannotated or annotated with a `torch` tensor type, including legacy ones. It matches the dim-0 assumption the existing warning documents (whose wording I updated). No per-model names, and no change to `support_torch_compile`. - **Limitations:** an unannotated parameter that receives a non-`None`, non-tensor value raises `Unsupported dynamic dimensions` at call time. A scan of the 36 buildable encoders in transformers 5.9.0 found no such parameter, no string annotations and no `list[Tensor]`, but I have not run them all. `list[torch.Tensor]` would be treated as a tensor. - **Not a duplicate:** no open or closed issue/PR covers `compile_mm_encoder` on the Transformers backend (searched on 2026-10-26). #63415 is the native RADIO/NaViT path in `radio.py`; #60202 is a separate positional-annotation bug in the decorator. - **Owners:** `vllm/model_executor/models/transformers/` and `tests/models/transformers/` are `@hmellor`; the two-line `.buildkite/test_areas/models_basic.yaml` wiring is `@khluu @Harry-Chen`. ---

**Manual end-to-end** (not CI; script from #63635, `compile_mm_encoder=True`, same A10G):

| Model | compile off | compile on |
|---|---|---|
| SmolVLM-256M-Instruct | `' Red.'` `[3950, 30, 49279]` | identical; `[Idefics3VisionTransformer] Compiling a graph for compile range (1, 2147483647) takes 20.65 s` |
| InternVL3-1B-hf | `'Red'` `[6033, 151645]` | identical; `[InternVLVisionModel] Compiling a graph for compile range (1, 2147483647) takes 19.14 s` |
| llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b | n/a | `torch._dynamo.exc.Unsupported: Unsupported context manager` (blocker 3, unchanged) |

CI runs this test on `:nvidia: (H200 MIG 35GB) Basic Models (Other)`, not an A10G. One image and a few greedy tokens only show that the encoder compiles and agrees with eager on that input.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tests for inferring an encoder's `dynamic_arg_dims` from its `forward`."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.compilation.decorators import support_torch_compile
+from vllm.model_executor.models.transformers.utils import infer_dynamic_arg_dims
+
+
+# The stubs mirror the `forward` signatures of the HF vision encoders they are named
+# after, so that the test does not depend on the installed `transformers` version.
+class UnannotatedEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Like `SiglipVisionModel`: the tensor input is unannotated."""
+
+    def forward(
+        self, pixel_values, interpolate_pos_encoding: bool | None = False, **kw
+    ):
+        pass
+
+
+class LegacyTensorEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Like `Idefics3VisionTransformer`: unannotated and legacy tensor inputs."""
+
+    def forward(
+        self, pixel_values, patch_attention_mask: torch.BoolTensor | None = None, **kw
+    ):
+        pass
+
+
+class AnnotatedEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Like `InternVLVisionModel`: annotated and legacy tensor inputs."""
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        pixel_values: torch.Tensor,
+        bool_masked_pos: torch.BoolTensor | None = None,
+        **kw,
+    ):
+        pass
+
+
+class NonTensorEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Arguments which are annotated as anything but a tensor are left static."""
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        pixel_values: torch.Tensor,
+        grid_sizes: tuple[int, int],
+        num_tiles: int | None = None,
+        *args,
+        **kw,
+    ):
+        pass
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "encoder_cls,expected",
+    [
+        (UnannotatedEncoder, {"pixel_values": 0}),
+        (LegacyTensorEncoder, {"pixel_values": 0, "patch_attention_mask": 0}),
+        (AnnotatedEncoder, {"pixel_values": 0, "bool_masked_pos": 0}),
+        (NonTensorEncoder, {"pixel_values": 0}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_infer_dynamic_arg_dims(encoder_cls, expected):
+    assert infer_dynamic_arg_dims(encoder_cls) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("encoder_cls", [UnannotatedEncoder, LegacyTensorEncoder])
+def test_inferred_dims_are_accepted_by_support_torch_compile(encoder_cls):
+    """`dynamic_arg_dims=None` raises `ValueError` for these encoders."""
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No dynamic dimensions found"):
+        support_torch_compile(dynamic_arg_dims=None)(type("E", (encoder_cls,), {}))
+    support_torch_compile(dynamic_arg_dims=infer_dynamic_arg_dims(encoder_cls))(
+        type("E", (encoder_cls,), {})
+    )

+def infer_dynamic_arg_dims(cls: type[nn.Module]) -> "DynamicArgDims":
+    """Infer `dynamic_arg_dims` from the signature of `cls.forward`.
+
+    The 0-th dimension is dynamic for every argument which is either unannotated
+    or annotated with a `torch` tensor type, including legacy ones such as
+    `torch.BoolTensor` which `support_torch_compile` does not recognise.
+    """
+    dims: DynamicArgDims = {}
+    for name, param in inspect.signature(cls.forward).parameters.items():
+        if name == "self" or param.kind in (param.VAR_POSITIONAL, param.VAR_KEYWORD):
+            continue
+        members = get_args(param.annotation) or (param.annotation,)
+        if param.annotation is param.empty or any(
+            getattr(m, "__module__", None) == "torch" and m.__name__.endswith("Tensor")
+            for m in members
+        ):
+            dims[name] = 0
+    return dims
